headline: Bitcoin is hovering around $80,000 as traders bet the Fed will raise rates in December; US growth and inflation data land at 19:30 Bangkok tonight, and Coinbase and Strategy report after the US close.

market.asOf: Snapshots from articles, because price pages could not be opened this run. BTC $80,159 (down 0.87% in 24 hours) per CryptoTicker at about 06:22 UTC Thu 29 Oct (13:22 Bangkok); Analytics Insight, citing CoinGecko the same morning, had $80,361 (down 1.1%). ETH $2,307 (down 2.4%) per CoinGabbar, citing CoinGecko at 04:15 UTC. SOL was 'roughly $100' per CaptainAltcoin at 06:45 UTC; no exact figure was confirmed. Live prices are at the top of the page.
market.fearGreed: 51 (Neutral) on the alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index on 29 Oct, per CoinGabbar. CaptainAltcoin reported at 06:45 UTC that the index had slipped from 46 to 44, without naming which index.

stories.title: Bitcoin stuck near $80,000 as traders now expect a December Fed hike
stories.summary: Bitcoin spent Thursday's Asian session trading near $80,000. After the Fed held rates on Wednesday with two officials voting for a hike, traders now see a December rate rise as the most likely outcome, which tends to weigh on riskier assets like crypto. A slide in big tech stocks after hours added to the caution.
points: The Fed held its rate range at 3.75-4.00% on Wednesday in a 10-2 vote; Lisa Cook and Beth Hammack wanted a quarter-point hike, per the Fed's statement.

Estimates of the odds of a December hike differ: 86% on CME FedWatch per CoinDesk, about 90% in bond markets per Bloomberg as cited by Analytics Insight, and roughly 80% per Reuters as cited by CaptainAltcoin.
About $259M of crypto futures positions were forced closed over 24 hours, more of them bets on falling prices ($156M) than on rising prices ($103M), per ChainCatcher.
Total crypto derivatives open interest fell about 7.35% to $318.6B, per CaptainAltcoin.
Alphabet shares fell after hours: about 7% per CoinDesk, about 10% per CaptainAltcoin.

sources.label: CaptainAltcoin: why the market is down

stories.title: Coinbase and Strategy report tonight, with forecasts for Coinbase all over the map
stories.summary: Coinbase, the US crypto exchange, reports third-quarter results after the US close on Thursday, and analysts expect a loss but disagree on how big. Strategy, the company that holds 848,517 bitcoin, reports the same evening.
points: Loss-per-share forecasts for Coinbase differ: an average of $0.12 per Yahoo and $0.28 per MarketBeat, both as cited by PrimeXBT. Revenue is expected around $1.20B.
Analysts' trading volume forecasts differ too: JPMorgan $173B, Barclays $147B, Oppenheimer $141B, per CoinDesk.
Strategy holds 848,517 BTC bought at an average of $75,446, per Yahoo Finance, so its bitcoin sits only modestly above what it paid.
Coinbase's live Q&A and Strategy's webinar are both at 5:00pm ET (04:00 Friday Bangkok), per the companies.

sources.label: PrimeXBT: Coinbase earnings date and estimates
CoinDesk: Wall Street divided on Coinbase
Yahoo Finance: Strategy holdings and Friday expiry

stories.title: Bitcoin funds take in money for a third day while ether funds keep losing it
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs took in money again on Wednesday, almost all of it into BlackRock's fund, while ether ETFs had a third straight day of withdrawals. A large monthly options expiry lands on Friday, which can make prices jumpy around it.
points: Spot bitcoin ETFs took in a net $137.33M on Wed 28 Oct, the third straight day of inflows; BlackRock's IBIT took $136.01M, per TokenPost.
Spot ether ETFs lost a net $21.41M the same day, their third straight day of outflows, per SoSoValue data reported by PANews. Analytics Insight, citing WazirX, instead reported inflows of $23.4M.
CryptoQuant says demand for bitcoin on spot exchanges has been negative every day since 14 Oct, despite the ETF inflows, per Analytics Insight.
Bitcoin options worth about $10.9B expire on Friday at 08:00 UTC (15:00 Bangkok), with 'max pain' at $78,000, per Yahoo Finance. Max pain is not a price target.

briefs.title: Crypto.com brings perpetual futures to US users
briefs.summary: Eligible US customers can now trade crypto perpetual futures (contracts with no expiry date) around the clock, with leverage capped at 5x, through the CFTC-regulated OG.com, per Blockhead.

briefs.title: MARA moves 1,000 bitcoin to BitGo
briefs.summary: Bitcoin miner MARA moved 1,000 BTC, worth about $80.66M, to custodian BitGo overnight, its fourth large transfer this month, per PANews as cited by Analytics Insight.

briefs.title: Tether freezes $27M; Hifi Finance hit by suspected attack
briefs.summary: Tether froze about $27M of USDT across at least 33 TRON addresses on 28 Oct without giving a reason, and a suspected governance attack on Hifi Finance minted 25M HIFI tokens and drained about $1M, per CoinGabbar.

briefs.title: Binance applies for a Brazil licence
briefs.summary: Binance applied to Brazil's central bank for a licence ahead of the 30 Oct deadline and delisted 22 tokens for Brazilian users, per crypto.news.

calendar.event: US Q3 GDP (first estimate), September PCE inflation and jobless claims
calendar.note: GDP expected 3.2% (Reuters poll, per IndexBox); Continuum Economics expects 2.8%. Prior 2.2%. Core PCE inflation expected 3.1% a year, prior 3.0%; jobless claims expected 196K, prior 194K, per Kaohoon.

Deposit rate 2.50%, per Admiral Markets. Kaohoon's calendar expects a hold; futures in late September priced about a 60% chance of a hike, per Admiral Markets. Press conference 9:45am ET (20:45 Bangkok).

Coinbase Q&A, Strategy webinar and Amazon call all at 5:00pm ET (04:00 Friday Bangkok), per the companies. Token unlocks the same day: FF (~$19.2M) and CARDS (~$17.7M), per the unlock data on this page.
Rate 1.25%; a hold is expected, per MUFG. Release time not confirmed.

At 08:00 UTC. About $10.9B of bitcoin options with 'max pain' at $78,000, per Yahoo Finance; CryptoTicker, writing on 17 Oct, put it at $12.2B with max pain at $79,000. Max pain is not a price target.
